title: Store Update 2.1.0
body:
# Store Update 2.1.0

Raiders!

Update 2.1 is now live, and with it comes the launch of the PvE toggle Beta Test. The reveal of this long-requested feature stirred up a mix of enthusiasm and doubt, so give it a try and share your thoughts. Your feedback, combined with data gathered in-game, will shape the decision on whether this toggle sticks around for good.

The Carrion Set has arrived in the store alongside a batch of fixes:

## ANIMATION

* Fixed a bug that sometimes made character models appear oversized.

* Fixed an issue where vaulting over destroyed ARC parts could send you or nearby debris flying into the air. Vaulting on the wreckage of Matriarch, Vaporizer, Hydra, and Firefly is now stable.

* Repeatedly swapping shoulders now triggers a brief cooldown before the animation switches sides again.

## AUDIO

* Toned down excessively loud footstep sounds outdoors and rebalanced footstep volume across different surface types.

* Added sharper visual and audio cues for melee hits that land on weak points, making it easier to tell when a strike connects well.

* Fixed a bug where repeated shoulder swapping could silence footstep audio.

* Added sound effects to the Cowboy emote.

* Made a number of smaller audio tweaks and additions.

## ARC

* Frigate hatches now deal burning damage over time once opened.

* Smoothed out collision on Frigate cargo so players no longer get stuck on its curved surfaces.

* Adjusted the Frigate cargo drop to stop unintended knockouts from occurring.

* Fixed unwanted interactions between throwables and certain doors aboard the Emperor.

## COSMETIC

* All players who have finished their fifth Expedition will now receive the previously missing Zenith Outfit toggles.

* The weapon tooltip now shows the rarity of any equipped weapon stencil.

## GAMEPLAY

* Fixed a bug where the Broad Shoulders skill failed to activate on spawn, blocking sprinting even when within the boosted carry limit. Inventory weight now updates properly after loading in.

* Fixed an issue where the Field Repair skill could stop working after being unlocked, if a round had already been played in that session. A restart is no longer needed for it to take effect.

* Fixed violent camera shaking that occurred when another player or vegetation passed between the camera and the player while firing.

* Fixed incorrect initial weight calculations when loading into a round.

* Fixed a bug where Fight or Flight incorrectly skipped the penalty tied to Sprinting on Fumes.

## ITEMS

**General**

* Mobile-Fire Grip Fittings now correctly require Skulker Targeters for research, rather than Skulker Drivers.

* Stamina-restoring consumables can no longer be used while the Sprinting on Fumes cooldown is active.

* A key part of balancing Sprinting on Fumes is the penalty applied once the ability ends. Items that let players sidestep that penalty undermine the intended risk of using the skill.

**Grappling Hook**

* Vaulting onto ledges and roofs with the Grappling Hook is now easier, particularly on Pendola Pass. Auto-vault triggers more reliably at the top of rope climbs, and landing a swing on walkable ground is more consistent.

* Fixed several problems that arose when the Grappling Hook allowed swinging from objects too light to support the player's weight.

* Fixed a bug where the Grappling Hook could detach from fast-moving objects such as the Ballistic Gondola, snapping the line during lift-off.

* The Grappling Hook's rope now wraps around geometry while the hook is in flight.

* Fixed an issue where Grappling Hooks and Tether Launchers failed to release when the player was downed by fall damage.

* Fixed a bug where Grappling Hooks and Tether Launchers at 0 durability were destroyed instead of simply breaking.

## MAPS

**General**

* Adjusted spawn points during Frigate rounds so players no longer start too far from the action in certain cases.

* Improved vaulting and traversal on rocky terrain to cut down on unintended sliding after a climb.

* Fixed world props in a tunnel that sometimes vanished when viewed from above.

* Improved lighting and reflections in Frigate areas and on Dam Battlegrounds, reducing visual artifacts and boosting performance.

* Improved shelter door interactions so players no longer get squeezed when opening them, with extra space added beside the door.

* Fixed various collision and clipping issues, gaps, and stuck spots across several maps.

**Pendola Pass**

* Fixed a bug where players could be eliminated even while inside the Gondola and extracting. Polished the terrain and collision across Pendola Pass, fixing gaps, clipping, and hard-to-traverse spots, cutting down on visual pop-in, and blocking off unintended areas.

* Fixed a traversal spot in the Railyard on Pendola Pass where jumping or auto stepping up did not work as expected.

* Polished Pendola Pass further with collision and visual fixes, corrected footstep and impact sounds on station canopies, and improved VFX culling so effects no longer show through surfaces.

* Adjusted interior snow and terrain blending to stop the landscape from clipping into buildings.

* Made night lighting darker with reduced visibility.

* Adjusted ARC Frigate cargo drop points on Pendola Pass to improve accessibility and prevent clipping.

## QUESTS

* Fixed quest objective progress bars displaying incorrectly while in Speranza.

* Fixed a bug where visiting loot-icon areas in Pendola Pass did not count toward the "Picking Up the Pieces" quest objective.

* Cinematics for "Sizing Things Up" now play correctly after the quest is completed.

## PERFORMANCE

* Reduced memory usage to improve stability on Spaceport, Buried City, and Dam Battlegrounds, with particularly noticeable benefits on Xbox Series S.

## UI

**General**

* Extended the compass and map visibility distance for Gondola markers from 120 to 175 meters.

* Improved the placement of pings on the Skulker and Bully when marked from long range.

* In the Weapon Amplification tree, hovering over or focusing an upgrade now highlights the path to that node, unless the path is blocked.

* Fixed a bug where spectating could fail to display squadmates' HUD info, making it look as though they had no Shield.

* Added a new indicator and seen-state tracking for weapon stencils on the customization screen, making newly acquired stencils easier to spot and manage.

**Reward Pass**

* Fixed an issue where the Reward Pass would not progress as intended. The End-Of-Round Reward Pass screen no longer wrongly counts milestones from earlier rounds.

* Polished the Reward Pass completion screen: updated button labels, fixed an incorrect premium icon showing on non-upgrade buttons, and adjusted the layout to stop image cropping and text overflow.

* Fixed the Reward Pass tile overstating the number of completed levels, and aligned the completion icon with the "Completed" label.

* The Reward Pass details screen now displays the name of the active pass.

**Outpost**

* Fixed an issue where Outpost module recipes stayed in the tracker after being installed.

* Added an orange indicator to the Outpost tab when a project step is completed, making new updates easier to notice.

* Fixed a bug where leaving Customization in the Outpost could leave the camera view out of focus.

* Fixed an issue where exiting the decorating mode in a module room sent players back to the base room instead of the room they had been editing.

**Skill Tree**

* Fixed a bug where the Field Salvaging skill could fail to show the correct items if unlocked after a round had already been played in that session.

* Fixed an issue where camera movement could be blocked if Field Salvaging or Field Repair was interrupted.

* Fixed a bug where End of Round inventory weight and max loadout weight failed to reflect character skills such as Reduced Weapon Encumbrance or Max Carry Weight.

## WEAPONS

* Fixed an issue where the Semi-Auto Amplification for the Hairpin failed to apply reduced headshot damage.

See you Topside, The ARC Raiders Team
